import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["readings"].copy()

    # Row-level rule: value IS NULL OR value < 0 OR value > 1000 -> bad
    bad = df["value"].isna() | (df["value"] < 0) | (df["value"] > 1000)
    df["_bad"] = bad

    # Per-batch aggregation
    grouped = df.groupby("batch_id")["_bad"].agg(
        bad_count="sum", total_rows="count"
    )
    grouped["reject_pct"] = grouped["bad_count"] * 100.0 / grouped["total_rows"]
    grouped["quarantine"] = grouped["bad_count"] * 100 > grouped["total_rows"] * 20

    df = df.merge(
        grouped[["quarantine", "reject_pct"]],
        left_on="batch_id",
        right_index=True,
        how="left",
    )

    quarantine_mask = df["quarantine"].fillna(False)

    # Quarantined batches: all rows (good and bad) go here
    readings_quarantine = df[quarantine_mask].copy()
    readings_quarantine["batch_reject_pct"] = readings_quarantine["reject_pct"].round(2)
    readings_quarantine = readings_quarantine.drop(
        columns=["_bad", "quarantine", "reject_pct"]
    )

    # Non-quarantined batches: split into clean / rejects
    rest = df[~quarantine_mask]
    readings_clean = rest[~rest["_bad"]].drop(
        columns=["_bad", "quarantine", "reject_pct"]
    )
    readings_rejects = rest[rest["_bad"]].drop(
        columns=["_bad", "quarantine", "reject_pct"]
    )

    return {
        "readings_clean": readings_clean.reset_index(drop=True),
        "readings_rejects": readings_rejects.reset_index(drop=True),
        "readings_quarantine": readings_quarantine.reset_index(drop=True),
    }
